summary: Between August and early September 2025 three overlapping infrastructure bugs intermittently degraded Claude's responses: a context window routing error, output corruption on TPU servers, and an approximate top-k miscompilation. Anthropic's postmortem says quality was not reduced for demand, time of day or server load.

overview.background: Claude is served on several hardware platforms and clouds. Routing, compilers and sampling code sit between a request and a response.
systems: Request routing to context-window server pools
Claude API TPU servers and runtime optimisations
XLA:TPU compiler and approximate top-k token selection
overview.impact: Some requests got worse answers. At the worst hour (31 August) the routing bug affected 16 percent of Sonnet 4 requests, and about 30 percent of Claude Code users had at least one message misrouted.
overview.severity: Intermittent quality degradation over several weeks, with different symptoms per platform.
overview.gaps: The page does not state the percentage affected for bugs 2 and 3.

archNote: Components and relationships come from the cited source where it describes them. Layout and labels are ours.

diagrams.title: Three bugs, three layers
diagrams.caption: Per Anthropic: a routing error sent some Sonnet 4 requests to servers set for the 1M-token context; a TPU misconfiguration sometimes gave high probability to unexpected tokens; a compiler bug sometimes dropped the highest-probability token.

nodes.label: Routing error: short requests to long-context servers
Users see degraded or odd responses

diagrams.title: Continuous production quality checks (conceptual)
diagrams.caption: Anthropic lists more sensitive evaluations, continuous checks on production and faster debugging tools.

afterChanges: Degradation is measured, not just reported.
afterNote: The after picture shows the corrective ideas in the source and general good practice. It is conceptual unless the source says otherwise.
timelineNote: Times are as published by the source. Entries without a clock time are given in order only.

timeline.e: The context window routing error is introduced.
The TPU misconfiguration is deployed and a change triggers the compiler bug.
A load balancing change increases misrouted traffic.
The routing error peaks at 16 percent of Sonnet 4 requests in the worst hour.
The TPU misconfiguration is rolled back.
The routing fix is deployed and Haiku 3.5 is rolled back.
Opus 3 is rolled back for the compiler bug.
The routing fix reaches first-party and Vertex AI by 16 September and Bedrock by 18 September.

rootCause.underlying: A routing error, a TPU misconfiguration and a compiler bug each degraded responses in different ways.
contributing: Routing was sticky, so follow-up requests hit the same wrong server
A December 2024 workaround had masked an underlying top-k problem
Evaluations missed what users saw because Claude often recovers from isolated mistakes
Privacy controls limited engineers' access to user interactions

evidence.label: Policy statement
evidence.body: We never reduce model quality due to demand, time of day, or server load.

evidence.label: A simulated output check
evidence.body:
def odd_chars(text, allowed=('en',)):
    return [c for c in text if ord(c) > 0x2E80]  # CJK range in an English reply
evidence.note: An illustration of a deployment check for unexpected characters. Not Anthropic's test.

diagnose.step: Compare reports by platform, model and time.
Check recent routing, config and compiler changes.

verify.step: Run evaluations that separate working from broken.

prevent.step: Add detection tests for unexpected characters.

fix.safety: Debugging with user data must respect privacy controls. Use feedback users submit.

troubleshoot.scenario: Users say answers are worse. Your evaluations look fine. Three platforms show different symptoms.
troubleshoot.question: How do you investigate?
hints: What do you change in evals?
troubleshoot.answer: Reproduce per platform, line up changes with report spikes, roll back suspects one by one and add sensitive production evaluations.

rootcause.q: What did the routing bug affect?
options: Some Sonnet 4 requests sent to long-context servers

remediation.answer: Sample live traffic and score against a reference.

design.prompt: Design quality assurance for a multi-platform inference service.
design.answer: Per-platform canaries, production evals, exact math fallbacks, rollbacks and feedback tooling.
